description: This file defines interfaces related to cache eviction strategies and purge notifications within the Orleans streaming infrastructure. It declares IEvictionStrategy for eviction logic, and IPurgeObservable for cache purging behaviors.

classes.name: IEvictionStrategy
classes.description: Interface for eviction strategy, managing purge actions and cache interactions.

classes.name: IPurgeObservable
classes.description: Interface for observable purge-related actions within a cache.

methods.name: PerformPurge
methods.description: Method to execute purge process at a given UTC time.

methods.name: OnBlockAllocated
methods.description: Method called when a new buffer block is allocated.

methods.name: RemoveOldestMessage
methods.description: Removes the oldest message from the cache.

methods.name: Newest
methods.description: Property to get the newest message in the cache.

methods.name: Oldest
methods.description: Property to get the oldest message in the cache.

methods.name: ItemCount
methods.description: Property providing the count of items in the cache.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Indicates if the cache is empty.
